sources.section: אף כי subsection2, in a question
sources.finding: Gen3:1 is explicitly listed in this question use.
Gen3:5 is listed twice. Other plural divine senses are also present in the entry; the listing does not exhaust syntactic alternatives.
Gen2:17 and Gen3:4 are listed among doubled death forms; this is not proof of a universal rule for negation scope.

limits: Model claims about universal negation grammar, certain speaker motives or paragogic-nun force were not adopted as established facts.
The imported 1cp analysis of ממנו in 3:3 is preserved; contextual translation selects from it.
God/divine beings and the attachment of the plural knowing participle remain revisable choices.
